## Development

```sh
cp .env.example .env
cp api/.env.example api/.env
cp web/.env.example web/.env
make build
make up
make migrate
```

`webscaf` creates these local environment files during initial generation. Run
the copy commands after cloning the generated repository on another machine.

- Web: http://localhost:3000
- API: http://localhost:8000/api
- Health: http://localhost:8000/health
- MailHog: http://localhost:8025

## Commands

```sh
make logs
make logs_api
make logs_web
make ps
make check
make test_e2e
make build_prod
make down
make down_volumes
```

Use production Compose settings with `ENV=prod` after configuring production secrets and database settings in the backend environment file.

```sh
make build ENV=prod
make migrate ENV=prod
make up ENV=prod
```

The backend is in `api/` and the frontend is in `web/`. Their original Makefiles remain available for framework-specific commands.

## Architecture and AI instructions

Project-wide instructions are in [`AGENTS.md`](AGENTS.md). Backend and frontend
changes delegate to the framework-specific instructions and architecture
contracts that came from the selected scaffolds:

- API: [`api/AGENTS.md`](api/AGENTS.md) and

The API architecture may follow HUMQ or framework-native conventions depending
on the selected backend. Do not replace its local contract with another
pattern's rules.
